pages.title: Advancing Graphite. Creating Industrial Value.
pages.summary: Developing a graphite processing and value-addition project in Mpwapwa, Dodoma, Tanzania.
pages.body: We aim to connect Tanzania’s mineral potential with industrial applications through appropriate processing technologies, responsible development and strategic partnerships.
pages.seo: Graphite Industries Limited | Graphite development in Tanzania

pages.title: A considered approach. A shared ambition.
pages.summary: A Tanzania-focused enterprise evaluating opportunities across graphite processing and industrial value addition.
pages.body:
Our vision is to connect Tanzania’s mineral potential with industrial applications and market opportunities. We aim to establish a technically sound and responsibly managed project through systematic evaluation and collaboration.

Our development strategy brings together feedstock verification, mineralogical characterisation, metallurgical testing and market assessment. Technical evidence and customer requirements will guide the scope of development.

We welcome experienced organisations that can contribute expertise, technology and long-term commercial insight.

pages.title: The Mpwapwa Project.
pages.summary: Evaluating an integrated graphite processing and value-addition project in Mpwapwa District, Dodoma Region.
pages.body:
The project is at a development and planning stage. It is not an operating mine or commissioned processing facility.

The current project brief includes a planning ROM feed capacity of 2,000 tonnes per day. This is a preliminary, unvalidated assumption; final capacity and process configuration will depend on studies and investment decisions.

Feedstock suitability, mineral rights, land tenure, water, electricity, logistics, environmental requirements and financing remain subject to verification and assessment.
pages.seo: Mpwapwa graphite project | Graphite Industries Limited

pages.title: From graphite to industrial possibility.
pages.summary: Potential product pathways shaped by feedstock characteristics, technical feasibility and customer requirements.
pages.body:
Graphite concentrate, micronised graphite and expandable graphite are potential pathways for evaluation. No commercial product specifications, recoveries or production volumes are currently asserted.

Product development will require laboratory testing, appropriate process design and customer qualification. Any product offering will be defined through verified technical and commercial evidence.
pages.seo: Potential graphite products | Graphite Industries Limited

pages.title: Responsible development starts with the decisions we make today.
pages.summary: Environmental stewardship, inclusive participation and accountability are intended to guide project planning.
pages.body:
Environmental priorities include water stewardship, energy efficiency, dust and noise controls, waste and tailings management, rehabilitation and biodiversity assessment.

Social priorities include worker safety, community engagement, local employment, skills development and gender inclusion.

Governance priorities include accountability, ethical conduct, regulatory compliance, procurement integrity and risk management. Specific targets and performance reporting will be developed when verified baselines and monitoring systems are available.

pages.title: Build the next chapter with us.
pages.summary: We welcome preliminary discussions with organisations that can contribute to project evaluation and development.
pages.body:
Engagement opportunities include geological services, laboratories, metallurgical testing, process engineering, technology provision, infrastructure, logistics, industrial buying and strategic investment.

Engagement begins with a non-confidential introduction, followed by scope definition and appropriate due diligence. Any cooperation is subject to mutually agreed terms, applicable approvals and internal authorisation.

The corporate project brief is an introductory draft. It is not an offer to invest, a feasibility study or a mineral resource or reserve statement.
pages.seo: Investors and partners | Graphite Industries Limited

privacy.title: Privacy notice.
privacy.summary: How this website handles enquiries and optional visitor measurement.
privacy.body:
Information you choose to share

Our enquiry form collects your name, email, organisation, enquiry category and message to review and respond to your request. Do not submit sensitive or confidential information.

Website measurement

Optional first-party analytics record page visits, referring hostnames and document clicks after you accept analytics. A random session identifier is used to count visits; the application does not store IP addresses or infer your country. Your preference is saved in this browser.

Access and questions

Contact ce@graphiteindustries.co.tz to ask about your enquiry information or request correction or deletion. Information is accessible to authorised staff. The company must confirm its retention schedule and applicable privacy arrangements before public launch.

terms.title: Website terms.
terms.summary: Information about preliminary project materials and use of this website.
terms.body:
Preliminary project information

This website introduces a proposed development. Information does not constitute an offer to invest, a resource or reserve statement, or a guarantee of project performance. Planning figures are subject to verification and change.

Illustrations and documents

Supporting imagery is illustrative unless expressly identified otherwise. Documents marked draft remain preliminary. Enquiries do not create a contractual commitment.

Contact

Questions about this website may be directed to ce@graphiteindustries.co.tz.
